newsitem.title: USA: Conrail appeal hearing ends without ruling.
newsitem.headline: Conrail appeal hearing ends without ruling.

text.p: A federal appeals court hearing of Norfolk Southern Corp's challenge of the U.S. district court's rejection of its request to enjoin Conrail Inc's board has ended without a ruling from the bench.
Norfolk Southern had sought to block Conrail's directors from proceeding with a merger agreement with CSX Corp.

Norfolk Southern was joined in its appeal by lawyers for the class action by Conrail holders claiming the railroad's information on the porposed merger did not adequately disclose the full value of Conrail stock given certain contingencies.
Lawyers and Wall Street analysts at the hearing speculated the appeals court would issue a written order in six-to-eight weeks.
